qc.label_under_test: The opening pieces of an intense, extreme verdict word that is still being spelled out over several tokens, strongest right after is/was: the first word of a vivid hyphenated praise or awe compound or idiom (jaw-dropping, eye-watering, mind-blowing, first-rate, first-class, world-class, out of this world) and inner chunks of a strong judging word written in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, AMAZING, TERRIBLE). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase as one token (incredible, terrible, amazing), on mild or middling verdict compounds (second-rate, run-of-the-mill), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor, top-down), on literal phrases (around the world), and on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED).

neighbours.label: The opening pieces of a strong verdict word that is still being spelled out over several tokens, good OR bad alike, strongest right after is/was: the first word of a vivid or ranking hyphenated verdict compound (jaw-dropping, mind-blowing, gut-wrenching, eye-watering, world-class, first-rate, second-rate, bottom-tier), 'out of this world', and inner chunks of a strong judging word written in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, FABULOUS, HORRIBLE, TERRIBLE). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase as one token (incredible, terrible), on mild verdict compounds (half-baked, so-so, run-of-the-mill), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor, top-down), on literal phrases (around the world), and on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED).
fire: The final scene of the movie was jaw-dropping from start to finish.
Honestly, her solo was mind-blowing and the crowd went silent.
The documentary about the flood is gut-wrenching to watch.
The bill at that steakhouse was eye-watering, even for a birthday.
Their new pastry chef is world-class, no question.
The service at the hotel was first-rate all week.
Critics said the sequel was second-rate compared to the original.
That team's defense is bottom-tier this season.
quiet: The final scene of the movie was incredible from start to finish.
Honestly, her solo was terrible and the crowd went silent.
The documentary about the flood is so-so to watch.
The bill at that steakhouse was run-of-the-mill, even for a birthday.
Their new pastry chef's plan is half-baked, no question.
The service desk is on the first-floor lobby all week.
Critics said the sequel used a top-down camera style compared to the original.
That team's defense is ranked twelfth this season.

predictions: Polarity should not matter: second-rate and bottom-tier fire like first-rate and world-class; expect 6-7/8 fire and 0-1 near misses.
